body: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen studied time-series momentum in 58 futures and forward contracts across asset classes using more than 25 years of data. Own past 12-month excess returns predicted subsequent returns in their sample, with later partial reversal. This differs from cross-sectional relative-strength ranking. It does not validate a particular single-stock signal or guarantee outperformance after costs.

title: Technical research: time-series trend momentum and its limits

body: The French monthly momentum factor uses six value-weighted portfolios sorted on size and prior months 2-12 returns. Momentum equals one-half Small High plus Big High, minus one-half Small Low plus Big Low. The most recent month is excluded from the formation return. Do not substitute a 12-month return including month 1 and call it the same factor.
review_method: primary publisher page reviewed; original concise summary, not full article
title: Quant factor definition: French monthly momentum construction
